content.title: Chapter 70 - PERSONNEL RULES — Sec. 70-64. - Call-back pay.
content.summary:
Regular and probationary non-exempt employees who are called back to work outside
               of their regular work hours shall be paid in accordance with applicable federal and
               state laws and a policy established by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023;
